qualification: Fully implemented means the finding is addressed and its relevant checks pass in the qualified desktop contract. Native ML is qualified for Windows x86_64 CPU. This does not claim universal platform support, calibrated ML accuracy or zero regressions. Partially implemented findings identify exact missing capabilities, external dependencies or qualification gaps. Provider HTTP transport is tested using a localhost synthetic server; no authenticated vendor requests were made. RBAC is a local session capability policy, with no multi-user authentication.
